segments.ja413:1.3: Api brāhmaṇa jānāsi, ko eko bahu socati.
segments.ja413:2.1: Brāhmaṇo ajayūthena, pahūtedho [bahūtejo (pī. ka.), bahutendo (syā.)] vane vasaṃ;
segments.ja413:3.1: Tassa taṃ dhūmagandhena, sarabhā makasaḍḍitā [makasadditā (sī. syā.), makasaṭṭitā (pī. ka.)];
segments.ja413:4.1: Sarabhesu manaṃ katvā, ajā so nāvabujjhatha;
segments.ja413:4.3: Āgacchantī vajantī vā [āgacchanti vajanti vā (syā. pī.), āgacchantiṃ vajantiṃ vā (ka.)], tassa tā vinasuṃ [vinassuṃ (sī.)] ajā.
segments.ja413:6.1: Sarabhe ca gate disvā, ajā ca vibhavaṃ gatā [aje ca vibhavaṃ gate (ka.)];
segments.ja413:6.3: Kiso ca vivaṇṇo cāsi, paṇḍurogī ca brāhmaṇo.
segments.ja413:7.1: Evaṃ yo saṃ niraṃkatvā, āgantuṃ kurute piyaṃ;
segments.ja413:7.3: So eko bahu socati, dhūmakārīva brāhmaṇoti.
